name: Entity Share Server
description: Allows to create channel entities to share content.
project_description:
Entity Share is a collection of modules allowing you to share content entities like nodes, taxonomy terms, medias etc. between different Drupal instances.

 Back to top 

 Documentation 
 Please read the documentation before creating new issue.

 
 
 
 
 Drupal 9+ 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Back to top 

 Support the Entity Share module 
 If you have a specific feature request, if you need dedicated support or if you want to support the module development and maintenance globally, please contact Entity Share's maintainer . We will see for a collaboration in the context of Smile like we have done with Lullabot for example.

 It will help accelerate the development of Entity Share. Smile sponsors Entity Share development, but depending on budget and availability we can't give answers to all support and feature requests.

 
 
 Requirements 
 
 JSON:API (Core) 
 
 
 
 
 Recommended modules 
 
 JSON:API Extras - Allows to customize the JSON:API endpoints and to enable full pager feature.
 
 Views Bulk Operations - Allows to update the import policy without having to reimport entities.
 
 
 
 
 Projects that extend Entity Share 
 
 Entity Share Async (sub-module) - Allows to import marked content asynchronously during CRON execution.
 
 Entity Share Diff (sub-module) - Provides diff of local and remote entities on the pull form.
 
 Entity Share Lock (sub-module) - Allows to prevent editing an imported content.
 
 Entity Share Cron - Allows to import content periodically using CRON.
 
 Entity Share Websub - Allows the server website to notify client websites, which had subsribed for content notification, to import updated content.
 
 ECA Entity Share - Integration with ECA .
 
 
 
 
 Similar projects and how they are different 
 
 Entity Pilot - Entity Share does not require any subscription to a service.
